standard_prerequisites.name: The cyclic graded modules V_{i,k} with their five families of defining relations, labelled r1 to r5 in the article, and the shift operation tau
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section 4.2, where the modules and their relations are set up before the counted statement; the five relations are referred to in the counted proof (source lines 641-648) as navigation-pointer stubs
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the relations against which the map has to be checked, and the module on which it is defined by the value on one generator.

standard_prerequisites.name: The two relations of the local Weyl module and of the Demazure module recorded in the lemmas labelled g and crucial
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked at the end of the counted proof (source line 649) as navigation-pointer stubs, each being counted separately in this lane
standard_prerequisites.use: Identify the last two defining relations with statements already proved for the current algebra modules.

core_obligations: Reduce to the defining relations: since the source module is cyclic, it suffices to show that the image of its generator satisfies the defining relations of the target, which the proof checks family by family (proof lines 640-641)

First family: the proof disposes of the case of the highest root directly, of the case of a root orthogonal to the highest root directly, and of the remaining case by invoking the vanishing of twisted negative root vectors in the next module of the family (proof lines 642-646)
Middle families: the next two families of relations are satisfied trivially by the chosen image (proof line 647)
Last families: the remaining two families are exactly the statements of the two lemmas labelled g and crucial, which gives the well-definedness and surjectivity of the map (proof lines 648-649)
proof_roadmap: 源模是循环的，故只需验证生成元的像满足目标模的定义关系。逐族检查：α=θ 时显然；α≠θ 且 (θ|α)=0 时显然；(θ|α)=1 时由 V_{i,k+1} 中 (x^-_{θ-α}⊗t^r)v̄_{i,k+1}=0（r ≥ k+1）得到。
r2、r3 两族对所选像平凡满足；r4、r5 两族恰是 lemma g 与 lemma crucial 的陈述，故该映射良定义且满。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts the existence of a surjective morphism of current algebra modules from a shift of the module attached to one pair of parameters onto the kernel of the first comparison map, fixed by its value on the cyclic generator (author proposition without an author label, statement at source lines 633-637). The proof (source lines 639-650) checks the five families of defining relations of the source module on the image of the generator: the first family splits into three cases according to the pairing with the highest root and uses the vanishing relations in the next module, the next two families are trivial for the chosen image, and the last two are exactly the statements of the two lemmas labelled g and crucial (proof lines 640-649). The case-by-case verification against the presentations is the content. H2.
